gap_question: 人体肿瘤微环境内肌苷（inosine）的生理浓度及其与 ICI 疗效的具体相关性数据是什么？
success_criteria: 找到报告人体肿瘤组织或微透析液中肌苷绝对浓度（如 μM 或 ng/mL）并与 ICI 响应（ORR/PFS/OS）进行统计关联的研究。

targeted_queries.query_text: human solid tumor tissue biopsy inosine concentration metabolomics immune checkpoint inhibitor response

What are the absolute concentrations of inosine measured directly in human solid tumor tissue biopsies or interstitial fluid, and how do these local levels correlate with objective response rate (ORR) or survival outcomes in patients treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors?
